detail.title: CP-UVR-0401F1V-I
features: Supports HDCVI, AHD, TVI, CVBS and IP video input
Supports up to 6 Channels IP camera input and each channel can be up to 6MP
4 Channels two-way talk over coaxial cable allows for seamless communication between the  camera, client and recorder
4 Channels IMD+ for analog channels or 6 Channels IMD by camera which allows the device to  trigger accurate alarms for humans and vehicles
4 Channels AI Coding saves on storage and bandwidth while               maintaining the details of targets in videos
Instastream, H.265, H.264+, H.264 dual stream video compression

General.IMD+ by DVR: 4 Channels: Secondary filtering for human and vehicle, reducing false alarms caused by leaves,  rain and lighting condition change
General.IP Camera Input: Up to 6 Channels of IPC access                                                                                                                               2 IP channels by default + 4 Channels (analog channels are converted to IP channels)                                   Incoming bandwidth: 32 Mbps, recording bandwidth: 32 Mbps and outgoing bandwidth: 32  Mbps
General.Video Frame Rate: Main stream: 5MP Mode: 4 Channels 5MP@(1fps-6fps), others 5MN@(1fps-12fps) 5M-N  Mode: 5M-N@(1fps–12fps), 4M-N/ 1080p@(1fps–15fps), 1080N/720p/960H/D1/CIF@(1fps 25/30fps)                                                                                                                                                                   Sub stream: D1/CIF@(1fps–15fps)
General.Video Display Split: When IP extension mode not enabled: 1/4                                                                                                    When IP extension mode enabled: 1/4/6
General.Video Compression: AI Coding, Instastream, H.265, H.264+, H.264
General.Protocols: HTTP, HTTPS, TCP/IP, IPv4, IPv6, RTSP, UDP, NTP, DHCP, DNS, SMTP, UPnP, IP Filter, FTP,  DDNS, SNMP, Alarm, Server, InstaOn, Auto Connect, IP Search, ONVIF 24.12 (Profile T, Profile  S, Profile G), CGI, SDK
General.Playback Mode: Instant playback, General playback, Event playback, Tag playback, Smart playback
General.General Alarm: Motion detection, HDCVI alarm, Camera external alarm, Network alarm, PIR alarm
General.Abnormality Alarm: Error (No disk, Disk error, Low space, Low quota space, Network disconnection, IP conflict,  MAC conflict), Video loss, Video tampering, Camera offline
General.Alarm Linkage: Record, Snapshot (panoramic), IPC external alarm output, Audio, Buzzer, Log, Preset, Email
General.Two-way Talk: Coaxial two-way talk: 4-channel BNC                                                                                                              Local and network user two-way talk: Shares the same audio input with the first channel
General.Disk Interface: 1 SATA port, up to 16 TB. This limit varies depending on the environment temperature
